extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians and advanced graduate students working in arithmetic geometry, particularly readers of Mochizuki's IUT papers
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed constructions and existence statements for local and global LGP-/lgp-monoids, Frobenioids, Kummer-theoretic correspondences, and related log-theta-lattice structures within the Inter-Universal Teichmüller Theory framework. The text gives algorithms, compatibilities, and structural properties rather than evaluation criteria.
